description: Let \(f:\{0,1,2\}\to\{p,q,r\}\) send \(0\) to \(p\) and \(1,2\) to \(q\). For \(S=\{1\}\) and \(T=\{2\}\), \(S\cap T=\varnothing\) and \(f(S\cap T)=\varnothing\), while \(f(S)=f(T)=\{q\}\). Thus \(f(S)\cap f(T)=\{q\}\ne f(S\cap T)\).
